title: Implement DDL execution backend endpoint
description: Implement the backend endpoint that executes DDL statements against PostgreSQL after user confirmation.
acceptanceCriteria: Backend executes DDL against chosen schema
Backend returns success on successful execution
Backend returns descriptive error on failure

resultEvidence.description: QA Automation verified all 4 acceptance criteria for the DDL execution backend endpoint. All executable acceptance criteria passed. Tests run in Docker container (node:20-alpine) per docker-test-runner skill. Typecheck (tsc --noEmit): PASS. Vitest: 74 passed, 7 skipped, 2 failed — the 2 failures are pre-existing integration tests in src/__tests__/integration.test.ts requiring a live PostgreSQL server (they test /api/v1/connections/test, not apply-schema) and failed identically on baseline. All 8 apply-schema unit tests pass. ESLint not applicable to backend (configured for frontend only).
acceptanceCriteriaMet: Backend endpoint accepts DDL statements (POST /api/apply-schema via applySchemaRouter) — verified by apply-schema unit tests
Backend executes DDL against chosen schema (set_config search_path parameterised, no SQL concatenation) — verified by apply-schema unit tests
Backend returns success on successful execution (200, success:true, message, ddlPreview) — verified by apply-schema unit tests
Backend returns descriptive error on failure (400 with error message, ROLLBACK on failure) — verified by apply-schema unit tests
architectureReview: SQL injection defence: set_config('search_path', $1, false) parameterised; no SQL concatenation of schema
Transaction safety: BEGIN/COMMIT/ROLLBACK wraps DDL execution (spec §5.3)
Statement timeout: 30s constant per statement, not user input (spec §4.6)
No-drops guard: DROP/TRUNCATE/DROP TABLE/DROP COLUMN/DROP CONSTRAINT rejected with 400
Confirmation guard: confirm must be true, no connection attempt otherwise
Connection lifecycle: client.end() solely in finally block (no double-end bug)
Error handling: descriptive messages, no stack traces leaked to client

testExecution.runner: docker run node:20-alpine (containerised, per docker-test-runner skill)
testExecution.command: docker run --rm --init --cap-drop ALL --security-opt no-new-privileges --pids-limit 512 --memory 2g --shm-size 1g --user $(id -u):$(id -g) --tmpfs /tmp -e HOME=/tmp -e npm_config_cache=/tmp/.npm -v $(pwd)/backend:/work:rw -v $(pwd)/qa-artifacts:/artifacts -w /work node:20-alpine sh -c "npm ci --ignore-scripts && npm run typecheck && npm test"
testExecution.results: Typecheck (tsc --noEmit): PASS; Vitest: 74 passed, 7 skipped, 2 failed (2 pre-existing integration failures requiring live PostgreSQL, unrelated to apply-schema); all 8 apply-schema unit tests pass
